name: Brethren Moon
description: (Tag:mental)(Tag:shapeshifter)(Tag:titanic-size)A Brethren Moon is a moon-sized near-godlike shapeshifting necromorph mass. It attacks with country-sized tendrils, uses interstellar telepathy, mind reading, and civilization-wide mind control, rewrites DNA, revives the dead as necromorphs, and achieves faster-than-light space travel, though powerful beings can resist.
